items.title: Dois Vizinhos (PR) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 1 #489
items.en_title: Dois Vizinhos (PR) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 1 #489
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Dois Vizinhos (PR) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 770,254.80; proposals close Dec 1, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
